- [Append iterations to an open run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/append-iterations-to-an-open-run.md): Appends
one batch of iteration results to a run opened by `runs/start`.
- [Authenticate and record an eval start](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/authenticate-and-record-an-eval-start.md
): Called by official SDK, CLI and Vitest runners before executing an eval. Requires an organization API key or saved-login bearer
. Records only start metadata, creates no dashboard run, and applies no debit or quota draw. Planned iterations are intent, not co
mpleted usage. Reuse the runStartId for ret…
- [Open a run for incremental ingestion](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/open-a-run-for-incremental-ingestion.md):
Opens a run that iterations are appended to, for a long CI job that reports as it goes. Pair with `runs/iterations` and `runs/fin
alize`.
- [Get a run's gate waiver](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-a-runs-gate-waiver.md): The waiver in force over t
his run, or `null`. Available to anyone who can VIEW the run, not only to those who can grant one — a waiver its readers cannot se
e is not a visible waiver.
- [Waive a run gate](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/waive-a-run-gate.md): Override a FAILING run's release gate u
ntil an expiry you name. This does NOT make the run pass: the run keeps its `result`, the waiver is a separate audited record, and
every surface that honors it — the GitHub Check Run and the CLI's `eval gate` — reports the gate as waived, by whom, why, and unt
i…
- [Revoke a gate waiver](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/revoke-a-gate-waiver.md): End a waiver early, putting the
gate and the GitHub Check Run back. Requires the manage tier.
- [Preview deterministic draft evaluators against stored evidence](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/preview-determi
nistic-draft-evaluators-against-stored-evidence.md): Requires suite configuration permission and a terminal run. Reserves a 60-sec
ond deterministic-preview cooldown, independent of judge previews. Supply the returned continuation object with the unchanged draf
t to read the next bounded population. Reads at most 100 iterations within a 30-second operat…
- [Read the organization's spend budget](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/read-the-organizations-spend-budget.md): Th
e ceiling on what this organization may spend on MCPJam-billed work — chat, evals, judges and computer time — in the current billi
ng window, and how much of it has been spent.
- [List a project's eval suites](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/list-a-projects-eval-suites.md): Eval suites in the
project with latest-run summaries and pass-rate trends — the `suiteId`s the eval-run routes take.
- [Search or list unified sessions](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/search-or-list-unified-sessions.md): The unified
, cross-surface sessions feed for one project: Playground, user-testing, eval, and swarm transcripts in one list, newest first. Pr
oject-NESTED (unlike `/chat-sessions`) because `projectId` owns the scope here rather than filtering it.
- [List a project's clients](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/clients/list-a-projects-clients.md): The clients saved in the p
roject — the named, reusable configurations that define how MCPJam connects to and talks to your MCP servers. Returns the `id`s an
d `configId`s the detail and write routes take. Clients that exist only as the private backing of a User Testing study are omitted
unless `inclu…
- [Create a client (from a template or a full config)](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/clients/create-a-client-from-a-templa
te-or-a-full-config.md): Creates a client in the project and responds `201` with the new client's detail. Seed the config one of t
wo ways: pass `template` (a built-in template id, optional `theme`) to seed server-side from the live backend client-template cata
log, falling back to the bundled SDK catalog snapshot if the live…
- [Get a client](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/clients/get-a-client.md): One client's full settings, including its resolve
d config, its `configId` (the concurrency token every write takes), and `impact` — what a config edit would follow. The path segme
nt accepts a client **name or ID**. A client that exists but belongs to a different project reads as `404 NOT_FOUND`.
- [Delete a client](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/clients/delete-a-client.md): Permanently deletes the client. Refused whi
le a live environment, an active legacy goal or an eval suite still holds it — the error names what to detach first. Guest callers
are denied (a write).
- [Update a client](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/clients/update-a-client.md): Edit a client's display name and/or its con
fig. Two ways to change the config: `config` replaces it wholesale, and `set` changes named fields over the config read inside the
write transaction — prefer `set`, because a whole-config round-trip composed from a stale read reverts whatever landed in betw…
- [Replace a client's servers](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/clients/replace-a-clients-servers.md): Replaces the client's
required and optional saved-server attachments without round-tripping the whole config. Composed server-side from the client's cur
rent config, so every other setting is preserved — and `expectedConfigId` is required so two concurrent server replacements cannot
silently lose one…
- [Duplicate a client](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/clients/duplicate-a-client.md): Creates a new client carrying the sel
ected client's current config, and responds `201` with the copy's detail. Purely additive — the source is untouched.
- [List server skills](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/primitives/list-server-skills.md): Returns the Agent Skills a connect
ed server serves over the MCP skills extension (SEP-2640), including skills it advertises that MCPJam declines to load. Not pagina
ted: the catalog is drained server-side, because duplicate detection spans the whole listing.
- [List a suite's settings history](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-suites/list-a-suites-settings-history.md): One entr
y per committed edit to the suite's settings, newest first: who made it, which STORED fields moved, the note they left, how many r
uns were launched against it, and the revision group that ties one request's writes together. Rows carry no configuration snapshot
s. Send a `revisionNumber` back…
- [Attach one environment to a suite (atomic append)](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-suites/attach-one-environment-to-
a-suite-atomic-append.md): APPEND one project environment to the suite's attachments, if it is not already there.
